# Third-party assets bundled in `web/vendor/`

## Inter (`inter/`)

Typeface by Rasmus Andersson. Licensed under the **SIL Open Font License 1.1**.
<https://github.com/rsms/inter> · <https://openfontlicense.org/>

Only the Latin and Latin-Extended subsets are included, as WOFF2.

## Phosphor Icons (`phosphor/`)

Icon set by Helena Zhang and Tobias Fried. Licensed under the **MIT License**.
<https://github.com/phosphor-icons/web>

`regular.css` / `fill.css` are the upstream stylesheets with the `@font-face`
`src` trimmed to WOFF2 only; the font files are unmodified.
